thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete for release/rf-2026-03-20 v2.3.0 -> eu-west-1. Running post-deploy smoke probes: synth-heartbeat, kv-warmup, perf-check. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rf-2026-03-20/2226001122
olivia: seeing some chattiness from eu-west-1 synth heartbeats, p95 latency looks elevated. @jamal any alerts? :eyes:
jamal: yep, p95 embed latency jumped to ~1.2s vs baseline ~320ms. 3/5 heartbeat probes failing.
```
SYNTH eu-west-1 2026-03-20T15:02Z FAIL latency=1200ms status=200 probe_id=hb-7
```
marco: grafana shows prefix-read latencies creeping up around the same time. KV warmup counts ok but tail latency up on a subset of hosts.
anya: my inclination is to hold and pin eu-west-1 back to v2.2.9 until we understand. Prefer pin over global rollback if possible.
olivia: agree. hold the rollout for eu-west-1. @jamal can you scale the canary pool down and pin routing?
jamal: starting scale down: `/deployctl scale --region eu-west-1 --pool canary --replicas 0` -> in progress.
deploy-bot: Action queued: scale canary (eu-west-1) -> 0. Expect completion in ~90s. Will post status.
jamal: scaled to 0. also seeing that embed-proxy CB tripped on 2/8 hosts; sticky-kv miss rate bumped.
marco: created incident INC-2345, linking traces and perf graphs. assigning to oncall. https://incidents.redwood/INC-2345
sre-oncall: oncall here, acked INC-2345. I'll correlate egress/network and kernel perf changes; can someone paste release notes?
olivia: release notes: https://docs.redwood/release/v2.3.0 changelog — notable: "attention kernel optimizations" + "prefix cache aggressive TTL default". Could explain higher tail latencies.
anya: decision proposal: pin routing in eu-west-1 to v2.2.9 for 30m window, stop rollouts to other regions, collect traces + KV cache metrics, then reconvene. Pin avoids full rollback and keeps global traffic stable.
olivia: +1. deploy-bot, apply pin; jamal, keep monitoring error budget and CB state.
deploy-bot: Routing update applied: eu-west-1 pinned to v2.2.9. Post-deploy probes will now exercise pinned variant.
marco: kicking off synthetic retriggers and collecting heap / kv cache stats. Putting trace links in INC-2345.
jamal: watching dashboards and logs. I'll post a short status in 20m or earlier if things change.
olivia: thanks. documenting decisions here for release notes + postmortem if needed. No global rollback for now — pin only. :white_check_mark: 
anya: also adding a follow-up: run a staged config rollback for the "prefix cache TTL" default as a hypothesis test if metrics don't improve in the pin window.
marco: noted. I'll prepare the config rollback runbook.
sre-oncall: oncall will continue correlation; ping me on the incident thread for kernel-level traces.
jamal: quick helper command I ran for healthcheck:
```bash
curl -sS -D - https://eu-west-1.api.redwood/synth/heartbeat -H "X-Canary: true" | head -n 20
```
olivia: good. keep the thread updated. if p95 remains >800ms after 30m we escalate to rollback.
jamal: will do. status pinned -> v2.2.9, canary scaled, probes retriggering.
